title: Thư cuối D3 (nhẹ tay, giai điệu hòa vào)
about: C3 (the user's choice, now the dem-diu style) after the user asked for a piano 'a little less harsh': 30 % of its tune's notes were struck above 65, on the upright's harder, brighter samples, and in its quiet passages the tune stood out over a very soft left hand (brighter there than in its loud ones; the references are darker when quiet). D3: D1, the tune and the left hand nearer in loudness (the left hand 2 softer, not 6)
